Job Summary: 
The Principal, IT Contracts Manager serves as a trusted authority on contractual matters for our client IT, overseeing the full contract lifecycle from intake through transition to operations with a focus on our most complex and impactful agreements. This role plays a critical part in protecting the organization’s legal, financial, and operational interests by ensuring contracts are well-structured, compliant, commercially sound, and aligned with business strategy. This position partners closely with IT leaders, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and Vendors to enable efficient contract execution while managing risk. 
 
Key Accountabilities / Job Functions:
Accountability 1- Contract Drafting & Review (40%)

Collaborate with IT leaders and vendors to ensure contract language accurately reflects business intent, scope, pricing, timelines, performance obligations, and risk allocation.
Review, edit, and finalize a broad range of IT contracts, including but not limited to:


Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
Statements of Work (SOWs)
Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Contract Amendments
Other vendor and supplier agreements

 
Accountability 2- Negotiation & Risk Management (5%)

Collaborate with Sourcing and Legal to support contract negotiations with vendors and IT leaders, balancing pricing and legal risk with business objectives.
Partner with IT leaders, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, and Risk to ensure contracts include:


Security control obligations, audit rights, vulnerability remediation timeframes, and breach notification.
Data handling and regulatory clauses relevant to travel (PII, and PCI where applicable).
Business continuity/DR obligations (RTO/RPO), resiliency testing, and subcontractor controls.

Ensure contracts comply with internal policies, and industry standards.
Support audits, regulatory reviews, and internal controls related to contractual obligations.
Ensure proper approvals, signatures, and recordkeeping are completed in accordance with company governance standards.                                                                                      

 
Accountability 4 - Contract Lifecycle Management (5%)

Manage contract lifecycle, including intake, drafting, review, execution, storage, renewal, amendment, and termination.
Maintain an organized, searchable contract repository using contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools or internal systems.
Ensure post-execution obligations are clearly communicated to relevant internal teams.              

 
Accountability 5 - Stakeholder Collaboration (25%)

Ensure governance in place for managed service contracts and provide oversight.          
Partner with Sourcing on pricing, payment terms, and cost controls.
Ensure vendor and supplier agreements follow IT, Financial, Sourcing and Legal processes. 
Collaborate with IT Leaders to ensure vendor and supplier agreements meet operational needs.
Serve as a primary point of contact for contract-related inquiries across the organization.
Advise internal stakeholders on termination rights, and dispute resolution provisions where needed.
Ensure proper approvals, signatures, and recordkeeping are completed in accordance with company governance standards.

Develop and maintain standardized contract templates, clause libraries, and negotiation playbooks.
Recommend and implement improvements to contract processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and turnaround time.
Provide training and guidance to internal teams on contract basics, best practices, and risk awareness.
Support implementation or optimization of contract management systems.
